crossRefs.note: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…
You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the…
Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and…
who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

translations.web: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
translations.bsb: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
